integrity.computational_status: Corroborative finite-moment and seeded finite-noise simulations; analytic proof is independent of numerical data.
integrity.proof_dependencies: Stationary Dirichlet-mean transform, coefficient subexponential convolution asymptotics, monotone Tauberian theorem, Gaussian convolution and regular-variation scaling.
integrity.scientific_claim: A single outer-sphere boundary layer theorem for athermal stationary shell mass and small-thermal-noise leakage, with explicit all-dimensional coefficient.

scientific_limitations: Fixed integer spatial dimension at least two and fixed positive tumble, trap and propulsion rates.
Thermal boundary displacement is fixed in units of the thermal standard deviation; no joint dimension/thermal/noise-limit uniformity.
The exact stationary Dirichlet-mean transform and Gaussian convolution are established in prior literature; the new statements extract sharp boundary probabilities and coefficients.
Possible implicit overlap with broad Dirichlet-mean endpoint asymptotics remains; independent review has not been performed.
title: Exact spherical-edge mass and thermal leakage for an isotropic trapped run-and-tumble particle
